reported_error: ExpectedBytes: System.Object[] cannot be converted to System.Int64
cause: Windows PowerShell 5.1 ConvertFrom-Json emits a top-level JSON array as one pipeline object. The pyannote access check selected the entire audio manifest and passed an array of byte counts to Get-Download.
fix: Read-Json captures the converted value and then emits it normally, enumerating top-level arrays consistently on Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7.
regression_before_fix: Exact ExpectedBytes/System.Object[] error reproduced by tests/test_json_compat.ps1 with simulated 5.1 cmdlet output.
regression_after_fix: 4 compatibility cases pass, including the actual Test-HfAccess call with a stubbed download, scalar manifest sizes, array cardinality, nested configuration, and separate audio inventory.
core_tests: All 10 core cases pass, including an actual small public HTTPS download and resume/integrity check. All PowerShell sources parse.
test_runtime: PowerShell 7.6.9 on Linux; Windows PowerShell 5.1 cmdlet output simulated in the compatibility test.
